Title: Anastasz di Zagreb vs. Warsaw Station

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

I control the Warsaw Station and a Nosferatu Justicar in torpor.
During a referendum, Anastasz di Zagreb casts 3 votes against, then I
burn Warsaw Station to move my Nosferatu Justicar to the ready
region. Is Anastasz now only casting 2 against? I think so, because
there are many other effects that change a vampire's votes after it
has already cast them, so this seems roughly the same.

Thanks,
Ira

Name: Anastasz di Zagreb
[CE:V, KMW:PAl, BSC:X]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Tremere
Group: 3
Capacity: 8
Discipline: ani cel dom AUS THA
Camarilla Tremere Justicar: If there are any other justicars ready,
Anastasz gets 1 fewer vote from his justicar title. Anastasz may steal
1 blood as a ranged strike.

Name: Warsaw Station
[KoT:R]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Nosferatu
Cost: 2 pool
Master: unique location.
You may tap this card when a Nosferatu announces an undirected action.
If that action is successful, the acting Nosferatu untaps. You may
burn this card (even if it is tapped) to move a Nosferatu in torpor to
the ready region.

Messages.Author: LSJ
